title: Environment Act 2015 (Act No. 333)
citation: Environment Act 2015, Act No. 333 (2015/333), Niue Laws Vol 2 (Niue Legislation 2019), pp. 78 ff.
evidence: Section 2 is printed as "[Spent]" in the Niue Laws Vol 2 consolidation and no commencement date is printed. Opened https://www.gov.nu/media/pages/information/bfc8b91513-1764012795/niue_laws_vol2_ul2022.pdf on 2026-11-10 (HTTP 200, 4479554 bytes, application/pdf, sha256 456115c9eaaa430c4975e4d8c99804f71f1e9a60e83ff5d91f3b836fee77dd9c); the Tables list it as 2015/333 and no official page opened states a commencement date.
notes: Kept as the closest own Niue instrument although it is narrower than an F2 climate framework: it is an environmental protection Act (development consents, environmental standards for land, waste, freshwater, marine, air, noise, protected areas), and climate appears only in s.38(d)(vii), "dealing with climate change and natural disasters, including programmes relating to disaster risk management", as a function of the Environment Department. No climate framework Act, carbon tax or greenhouse-gas reporting rule was found in the Tables of Acts in force (as at 31 December 2019 and 2024; absence from the Tables, not a full-text sweep). Part 5 s.51 lets Cabinet "prescribe levies based on the polluter pays principle" on specified imported items or operations that produce a product that will or may have a significant environmental impact when it becomes waste; s.52 allows refunds for used items. No levy under s.51 was found in the Tables, so it is not an F3 entry. Link only: row NU-GON-CONSOLIDATED is permission requested. English only; the Acts opened are in English, and the Vagahau Niue Act 2012 (Act 321) is on gov.nu but no Niuean text of this Act was found. No government English translation is needed. The volume is a Victoria University of Wellington compilation as at 31 December 2019; no point-in-time versions are served.
